'''Tomato seeds''' are used to plant [[tomatoes]]. They replace {{MCW|Beetroot Seeds|beetroot seeds}}.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
One tomato crafts into 3 seeds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/tomato_seeds_from_tomato.json}}</ref> A fully grown tomato crop drops no seeds, so replanting uses tomatoes.

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

Tomato seeds are planted on farmland and grow into tomato crops. They can also be fed to chickens and used to breed them, as in vanilla.
